1- Arabic Sign Language Translator

Machine Learning & Deep Learning | Computer Vision | NLP

A machine learning project designed to bridge the communication gap between deaf and hearing individuals by translating Arabic Sign Language gestures into written Arabic text and spoken audio. The system uses computer vision and deep learning techniques to recognize sign language gestures from uploaded videos and convert them into understandable Arabic words.

Training data: 6,291 video samplesModel Accuracy: 93.25%
